artists.biography: Pop Will Eat Itself (also known as PWEI or The Poppies) are an English alternative rock band, originally formed in Stourbridge in 1986, with members from Birmingham, Coventry and the Black Country. Initially known as a Grebo act, their style changed to incorporate sample driven indie and industrial rock. Their highest charting single was 1993's "Get The Girl! Kill The Baddies!". After initially disbanding in 1996, and having a brief reformation in 2005, they issued their first release in over five years in 2010.

perplexity.description:
92° F / The Incredible PWEI Vs Dirty Harry" is a 1991 single by English alternative rock band Pop Will Eat Itself, released on RCA Records. Musically, the release exemplifies the band's signature fusion of electronic, hip hop, and rock elements, blending aggressive beats, sampled loops, and distorted guitar riffs. The A-side, "92°F," features Sylvia Tella on vocals and showcases the group's knack for merging danceable rhythms with industrial textures, while the B-side, "The Incredible PWEI Vs Dirty Harry," leans further into their experimental, sample-heavy style, reflecting the band's affinity for genre-blurring and sonic collage.

This single arrived during Pop Will Eat Itself's most prolific period, following their 1990 album Cure for Sanity and preceding their 1992 release The Looks or the Lifestyle?. It stands as a key example of the band's innovative approach to alternative music in the early 1990s, bridging their industrial rock roots with emerging electronic and hip hop influences. Commercially, "92°F" charted on the UK Singles Chart, peaking at No. 32, and also made an appearance on Billboard's Dance Club Songs chart in the US, highlighting its crossover appeal. The single was well-received for its bold production and genre experimentation, cementing Pop Will Eat Itself's reputation as pioneers of the UK's alternative scene.
